title: Automations
description: Rules that react to sensors, clocks or sunrise/sunset. The engine runs in the backend, so they keep working while the panel is off or disconnected.

form.description: Trigger, conditions and actions are validated by the server before they are stored.
form.name: Name
form.activeHint: A disabled rule stays stored but is never evaluated.
form.topicHint: MQTT wildcards allowed: + for one level, # for the remaining ones. MQTT_BASE_TOPIC is applied implicitly.
form.payloadKeyHint: Leave empty when the topic publishes a plain value.
form.expectedValueHint: ON/true/1 and OFF/false/0 are equivalent. Empty means any value.
form.cronHint: 5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (0 and 7 = Sunday).
form.sunOffsetHint: Negative fires before the event, positive after it.
form.conditionsHint: Inside a group conditions are ANDed; between groups it is an OR: one fulfilled group is enough.
form.groupEmpty: Empty group: it will be ignored.
form.requireAway: Requires the house to be empty
form.actionsHint: Run in sequence, in the order listed here: direct MQTT commands or whole scenarios.
form.actionScenarioEmpty: No scenario available: create one under Admin → Scenarios.
form.presetDeviceEmpty: No device with a command topic

errors.name: A name is required.
errors.actionTopic: Every action needs a command topic.
errors.actionScenario: Every scenario action needs a scenario.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: The rule and its whole execution history are removed from the database.

toast.testConditions: Conditions not met: no command was sent

warning: Automations publish real commands on the broker: run the test before leaving a rule enabled.
